Provenance of the SLOW5/BLOW5 test files in this directory
==========================================================

exp_1_lossless.blow5
    Copied unchanged from slow5lib, test/data/exp/one_fast5/exp_1_lossless.blow5
    (https://github.com/hasindu2008/slow5lib, commit
    76c4da00aac8290806311babebc3476cd8464d21). One read, SLOW5 file version
    0.1.0, record compression none, no signal compression, auxiliary fields
    channel_number, median_before, read_number, start_mux, start_time.

lossless_none_svb-zd.blow5
lossless_zstd_svb-zd.blow5
lossless_zlib_svb-zd.blow5
lossless.slow5.gz
    Derived from exp_1_lossless.blow5 with slow5tools 1.5.0
    (https://github.com/hasindu2008/slow5tools, commit
    8341d93b175cace57f8a6bae6049af6b87630e0c, built with zstd=1):
        slow5tools view exp_1_lossless.blow5 -c none -s svb-zd -o lossless_none_svb-zd.blow5
        slow5tools view exp_1_lossless.blow5 -c zstd -s svb-zd -o lossless_zstd_svb-zd.blow5
        slow5tools view exp_1_lossless.blow5 -c zlib -s svb-zd -o lossless_zlib_svb-zd.blow5
        slow5tools view exp_1_lossless.blow5 -o lossless.slow5 && gzip -9 -n lossless.slow5
